description: Apply the mechanical fixes for review findings instead of editing them one by one: api/coroutine-without-await, api/freed-check-order, api/get-meta-null-default, api/image-unit-bool, api/infer-variant, api/multimesh-format-after-count, api/packed-element-write, api/shader-removed-builtin, api/shader-renamed, api/timer-start-outside-tree, api/upgrade-area-mask, api/upgrade-mesh-skeleton, quality/mojibake, quality/packed-setter-skipped, quality/standalone-ternary, quality/string-signal, structure/duplicate-uid, structure/invalid-uid, structure/locked-instance-edit, structure/uid-path-mismatch, structure/unknown-uid, structure/unused-resource. Each fix rewrites only the line a finding points to, only when it looks exactly as expected, and is labelled `safe` (it only removes the problem, e.g. a freed check put first, emit_signal() as signal.emit(), Timer.start() after add_child(), a stale uid set from its path, a lost .uid restored, an unused resource section removed) or `check` (it changes more: an await that makes the caller a coroutine, a guessed type, a uid that named another file, [editable] added, a setter that runs again). Without `write` it shows the changes; with `write: true` it applies them and reviews the changed files again, returning what is left. Only safe fixes unless `include_check: true`. Lines it cannot fix are listed with the reason. Run godot_review first and godot_check after writing.

detail.description: brief (capped lists) or full (everything); default brief

from.description: release the project comes from, as in godot_review

include_check.description: also apply fixes labelled check (default false)

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

rules.description: only these rules (the fixable ones are listed above)

stamp_uids.description: also give scenes, resources, scripts and shaders without a uid a new one (header or .uid file)

write.description: write the fixes (default false: show them only)

name: godot_fix
title: Fix review findings mechanically
